feature_name: Handle Unknown Timezone in User Data Provider
description: Update the user data provider to handle cases where the browser returns an unknown timezone identifier. When the timezone cannot be determined or is invalid, the system should default to UTC instead of sending an unsupported timezone value to the backend.
functional_requirements: Modify the user data provider to detect when the browser returns an unknown or invalid timezone identifier
When an unknown timezone is detected, replace it with 'UTC' before sending to the backend
Ensure the fix prevents backend validation errors for invalid timezone values like 'Etc/Unknown'
